mapper.select: select #{codeArea} || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(10000, 99999))) || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(#{beginRange}, #{endRange}))) as nim from dual

select (#{codeArea} || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(10000, 99999))) || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(ste_ini_rango, ste_fin_rango)))) as nim from sitios_tecnotree where ste_rango = #{node} and sysdate between ste_start_date and nvl(ste_end_date, sysdate + 1)
select #{codeArea} || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(41699, 99999))) || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(#{beginRange}, #{endRange}))) as nim from dual
select #{codeArea} || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(1000, 9999))) || to_char(trunc(dbms_random.value(#{beginRange}, #{endRange}))) as nim from dual
select count(1) from cellulars where clu_cellular_number = #{cellularNumber}

select p.ppa_value || c.clu_bill_number as subid from cellulars c, prepay_parameters p where (c.clu_bill_number = #{billNumber} or c.clu_cellular_number = #{cellularNumber}) and p.ppa_name in ( select decode(c2.clu_type, 'CPP', 'PREFIJOS_GSM_CPP', 'MPP', 'PREFIJOS_GSM_MPP') from cellulars c2 where (c2.clu_bill_number = #{billNumber} or c2.clu_cellular_number = #{cellularNumber}) ) and sysdate between p.ppa_start_date and nvl(p.ppa_end_date, sysdate + 1) and rownum = 1
select rppr_rpl_id from rate_plan_profiles where rppr_gprf_id = #{profileId} and sysdate between rppr_start_date and nvl(rppr_end_date, sysdate) and rownum = 1
select count(1) from cellular_accounts where cac_id = #{id}
select count(1) from cellular_call_restrictions where ccr_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: begin delete from activation_ranges where acr_starting_range = #{cellularNumber}; insert into activation_ranges (acr_starting_range, acr_ending_range, acr_blc_block_code, acr_mpp, acr_bill_prefix, acr_start_bill_range, acr_end_bill_range, acr_starting_bill, acr_ending_bill, acr_usr_id, acr_add_date) values (#{cellularNumber}, #{cellularNumber}, #{blockCode}, 'N', substr(#{cellularNumber}, 1, case when #{expectedLineLength} = 10 then 3 else 2 end), substr(#{cellularNumber}, case when #{expectedLineLength} = 10 then 4 else 3 end), substr(#{cellularNumber}, case when #{expectedLineLength} = 10 then 4 else 3 end), #{billNumber}, #{billNumber}, nvl(#{subId}, 'WEB'), sysdate); end;

begin insert into cellulars (clu_cellular_number, clu_activation_date, clu_status, clu_add_date, clu_stg_id, clu_cmp_id, clu_acc_id, clu_dlr_id, clu_usr_id, clu_clt_id, clu_blc_block_code, clu_type, clu_cbt_id, clu_bill_number, clu_npa_digits, clu_pro_mode_type, clu_line_type, clu_tmt_id) values (#{cellularNumber}, sysdate, #{statusStealth}, sysdate, 'AH', 1, #{accountId}, #{dealerId}, 'STL', #{clientId}, #{blockCode}, 'CPP', #{businessType}, #{billNumber}, 2, 'GSM', 'COMERCIAL', '138C'); end;
mapper.update: update cellulars set clu_bill_number = #{billNumber} where clu_cellular_number = #{cellularNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into cellular_business_histories (cbh_clu_cellular_number, cbh_cbt_id, cbh_start_date) values (#{cellularNumber}, #{businessType}, sysdate)

insert into cellular_accounts (cac_id, cac_clu_cellular_number, cac_acc_id, cac_start_date, cac_end_date, cac_usr_id, cac_add_date) values (#{id}, #{context.cellularNumber}, #{context.accountId}, sysdate, null, 'WEB', sysdate)
mapper.select: select sim_imsi as imsi, sim_iccid as iccid, sim_msisdn as msisdn from sims where sim_msisdn = #{subId} and rownum = 1
mapper.update: update cellulars set clu_esn = #{esn} where clu_cellular_number = #{cellularNumber}
mapper.insert: insert into service_status (sst_clu_cellular_number, sst_service_status, sst_start_date, sst_end_date, sst_add_date, sst_usr_id, sst_rsn_id) values (#{cellularNumber}, #{statusStealth}, sysdate, null, sysdate, user, 'WACTIV')

insert into cellular_call_restrictions (ccr_id, ccr_cr_id, ccr_start_date, ccr_tck_id, ccr_rmr_id, ccr_usr_id, ccr_clu_cellular_number, ccr_rsn_id, ccr_end_date) values (#{id}, #{context.callRestrictionId}, sysdate, null, null, 'WEB', #{context.cellularNumber}, 'WACTIV', null)

declare v_end_date date := to_date('30/12/3999 11:59:59', 'dd/mm/yyyy hh24:mi:ss'); cursor c_requeridos(linea cellulars.clu_cellular_number%type) is select bsg_stg_id from business_service_type_groups, cellular_business_types where bsg_bus_id = cbt_bus_id and cbt_id = (select clu_cbt_id from cellulars where clu_cellular_number = linea) and bsg_required_flag = 'Y'; begin insert into cellular_plans (cpl_clu_cellular_number, cpl_stg_id, cpl_rpl_id, cpl_start_date, cpl_end_date, cpl_due_date, cpl_usr_id, cpl_add_date) select #{cellularNumber}, rpa_stg_id, rpa_rpl_id_assignment, sysdate, v_end_date, v_end_date, 'WEB', sysdate from rate_plan_assignments where rpa_start_date <= trunc(sysdate) and (rpa_end_date is null or rpa_end_date > trunc(sysdate)) and rpa_rpl_id_air = #{ratePlanSth}; for r_req in c_requeridos(#{cellularNumber}) loop insert into cellular_plans (cpl_clu_cellular_number, cpl_stg_id, cpl_rpl_id, cpl_start_date, cpl_end_date, cpl_due_date, cpl_usr_id, cpl_add_date) values (#{cellularNumber}, r_req.bsg_stg_id, #{ratePlanSth}, sysdate, v_end_date, v_end_date, 'WEB', sysdate); end loop; end;
mapper.select: select cpa_pkt_id from cel_business_types_packages where cpa_cbt_id = (select clu_cbt_id from cellulars where clu_cellular_number = #{cellularNumber}) and cpa_default_flag = 'Y' and cpa_start_date <= sysdate and cpa_end_date >= sysdate
mapper.insert: insert into cellular_packages (cpk_clu_cellular_number, cpk_pkt_id, cpk_activation_date, cpk_price_type, cpk_usr_id_is_load, cpk_move_type) values (#{cellularNumber}, #{packId}, sysdate, 'P', 'WEB', 'A')

insert into credit_limit_assignments (clas_clu_cellular_number, clas_pce_handle, clas_credit_limit_automatic, clas_credit_limit_manual, clas_credit_limit_manual_flag, clas_credit_limit_excedent, clas_excedent_expiry_date, clas_start_date, clas_user_id, clas_rsk_id, clas_rpl_id, clas_coefficient_value, clas_clu_bill_number, clas_credit_limit_autoscore, clas_score_id, clas_coefscore_value, clas_plan_price) values (#{cellularNumber}, #{handle}, 8400, null, null, null, null, to_date('12-07-2022 12:57:31', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'), 'PREPAGO', 'M', #{ratePlanSth}, 2, #{billNumber}, 6300, '1M', 1, 4200)
